title: Mexican Peso selloff deepens as Fed hawks drive USD/MXN toward 17.50
summary: The Mexican Peso extends its depreciation against the Greenback, as the USD/MXN pair rallies over 1.25% amid speculation that the Fed will raise rates more than once, with Fed officials leaning hawkish, underpinning the US Dollar.

title: China's Newest Power Plant Swaps Steam for Supercritical CO2
summary: China just broke ground on a revolutionary new hybridized energy production and storage facility. The power plant will store excess energy in the form of molten salt, and then produce electricity during peak demand times through a supercritical carbon dioxide system. The goal of the project is to limit energy waste while also stabilizing the local power grid. title: Ethiopia warns of ‘destruction’ as Tigray rebels launch offensive
summary: Ethiopian President Taye Atske Selassie warned of “forces of destruction” as Tigray rebels launched an offensive.
